title: Wednesday's peak in Lisbon: the airport forecast and IPMA's hourly model disagree
summary: The airport forecast (TAF, issued 23:00 Tuesday) has the strongest wind 09:00 to 16:00; IPMA's hourly model had it at 19:00 to 20:00. Our analysis (a hypothesis, labelled) widened the peak to 12:00 to 18:00. IPMA's red warnings are unchanged and are what counts: rain 09:00 to 18:00, wind 12:00 to 21:00.
closes: IPMA's station observations for Wednesday: the hour of the strongest gusts, measured. Not a forecast of ours.
